chapter.heading: A psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Oppose my
opponents, Lord; fight those who are fighting against me.

Put your
armor on, and pick up your shield. Get ready, come and help me.

Draw your
spear and your javelin, confront those who are chasing me. Tell me, “I am your salvation!”

Shame them!
Humiliate those who are trying to kill me! Turn them back! Disgrace those who are planning to hurt me!

Let them
be like chaff blown by the wind; let the angel of the Lord drive them away.

May their
path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord chasing them down.

For no
reason they set a net to catch me; for no reason they dug a pit to trap me.

Let disaster
come on them suddenly; let the net they set catch them instead; let the pit they dug trap them instead.

Then I
will be glad in the Lord; I will be happy in his salvation.

Every part
of me will say, Who can compare to you, Lord? You rescue the weak from the strong; the poor and needy from robbers.

Hostile witnesses
stand up to testify against me, accusing me of crimes I don't know anything about.

They pay
me back with evil instead of good. I feel like giving up.

But when
they were sick, I put on clothes of sackcloth in sympathy. I denied myself through fasting. May my prayer for them return to bless me too.

I was
upset for them, as if they were my own friends or family; I bowed down in grief as if I was mourning my own mother.

But when
I was in trouble, they gathered around and laughed at me. Even strangers I don't know attacked me, constantly tearing me apart.

Like irreligious
people mocking a cripple they mock me and call me names, gnashing their teeth at me.

How long,
Lord, will you sit by and just watch? Save me from their vicious attacks; defend the only life I have from these lions.

Then I
will thank you in front of the whole congregation and praise you in front of all the people.

Don't let
my enemies take pleasure in my troubles, those people who hate me and tell lies about me, gloating over me for no reason.

They are
not looking for peace; they invent malicious and deceptive schemes against innocent peace-loving people.

They open
their mouths wide to make accusations against me, saying, “Look! Look! We saw it with our own eyes!”

But Lord,
you've seen all this! Say something! Don't give up on me, Lord!

Wake up!
Get up and defend me, my Lord and my God! Take up my case and make sure justice is done!

Vindicate me,
my Lord and my God, because you are just and right. Don't let them gloat over me.

Don't let
them say to themselves, “Look! We got what we wanted!” Don't let them say, “We completely destroyed him!”

Make them
totally ashamed, all those who are happy for the trouble I'm in. Let those who are celebrating over me be covered with shame and dishonor.

Instead let
those who are pleased I've been vindicated celebrate and shout for joy. Let them always say, “How great is the Lord! He is happy when his servants live in peace and have what they need.”

I will
tell others about your character of truth and right, praising you all day long!
